arStrings.szText: "What is the meaning of your name, Justelle?"
We choose a name based on the five oaths we live by. I chose Justice. I was a child in a brutal world, nearly lost my life before I understood it.
Justelle is proud and happy to answer this.
But I saw enough. Enough to know I’d spend the rest of mine standing between the innocent and the dark.
Justice wasn’t just a word. It was something I carried.
